scope: Eighteen previously authored crops independently compared to actual original/reference/output and static placement pixels. Sixteen clear for development intent; Queen Fury cage mesh and Shrine wall relief require revision and remain excluded.

individualDispositions.reason: The lower-left and central native cargo-cage faces contain dense fine crossing mesh and narrow ribs. The output instead uses a substantially coarser orthogonal grid with heavy repeated upright frame bars and stronger rim highlights, changing the face construction. Restore the fine source lattice spacing/directions and subdued rim exposure; retain the separate upper-right fragment and stack positions.

The leaning cabin cupboard panel retains the rising rounded top, narrow upper/lower dark braces, small dark left fitting, warm timber palette and open-panel placement. Wood-grain detail does not introduce a new motif.

The three unequal cap pieces, broad flared shoulders/base and green longitudinal variation remain source-bound. The surface stays a green architectural face with no new foliage, readable symbol or named material identity.

The rear throne keeps its asymmetric posts, inward diagonal gray-green back bands, narrow dark-red inset and seat, and dark mottled front. The front variation remains non-readable decoration; no new identifiable emblem is cleared.
The broad irregular shadowed arch body and narrow lower shaft retain their cut542 shape and dark teal illumination. Texture is restrained and the crop remains an occluding architectural fragment.
The separate cut544 arch preserves its wider lower shaft and angled bright foot/band, distinct from cut542. Dark teal upper shading and source geometry remain intact.

The chair retains its leaning curved oval back, projected rounded seat, pale cool frame, slender legs and dark-red upholstery. Sparse warm flecks remain texture rather than a newly readable coat of arms.

The asymmetric openwork cap, narrow support stem, thicker banded base and cropped lower-right stepped face preserve their source configuration. The cap remains an unresolved sculptural shape, with no invented creature or figure.

The folded pale-green fragment retains its upper projection, central-left recess, curled right edge/recess and oblique room placement. Added shading keeps the fitting ambiguous rather than assigning a leaf, animal or face.
The unequal narrow green steps, dark separators and tapered mottled base remain source-bound beneath the display legs. Added mottling is irregular and does not become an emblem or coherent glyph.

The blue pointed finial, thin open purple arms, central stem and low collar retain their shapes and placement. The cropped purple-gray pedestal preserves its cream diagonal sunlit edges and shadow direction.

The native upper wall patch is a subdued violet-brown flat field with disconnected pale fragments and faint surface remnants. The output introduces conspicuous brown cobble-like raised blocks, dark joints/cracks and relief across that upper field. Keep the patch flat, restore the native violet-brown tonal field and isolated pale marks, and confine new detail to fine continuous shading/moss.

The dark circular wall fitting preserves its unequal radial sectors, warm hub, pale upper-left inner mark and diffuse orange-brown surrounding wall. The supplied static placement is fully occluded by another native sheet, so visible/script-state placement is not established.

The two unequal red hanging forms retain the cream patch distribution, narrow suspension, central dark gap and dark horizontal backing bands. No exact object identity is assigned. The supplied placement is occluded by a native sheet and cannot prove visible placement.

The pale green-gray left forms, narrow central upright, purple right container and dark curved brown lower plane keep their counts, colors and relative positions. Small reflective detail remains within the observed source forms.
The broad pale-rimmed bowl-like furnishing retains the orange-brown upper mass, teal/mauve body patches and unequal feet. The output does not add a specific creature, motif or new contents.

The small brown fitting keeps the clipped upper projection, curved face, elongated lower-left support and unequal pale central/right marks beside the couch. Its tiny specific identity remains unresolved.

The dark red table keeps the curved leg silhouette, warm ochre upper mark, narrow brown upright and unequal tiny pale items in the same positions. Wood detail is conservative; no precise identity for the small tabletop items is cleared.
